expectations.text: States the Act has nine chapters and 44 sections
expectations.evidence: "44 sections plus one Schedule" and enumerates all nine chapters (Chapter I through Chapter IX)

expectations.text: Maps appeal to the Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT) to Section 29
expectations.evidence: "Appeals to the TDSAT: Section 29 (Chapter VII). It makes the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal the Appellate Tribunal"
"Voluntary undertaking: Section 32 (Chapter VII). The Board may accept a voluntary undertaking"

expectations.text: Maps Chapter VI to the Board's powers and procedure (ss.27-28) and Chapter VIII to penalties (ss.33-34)
expectations.evidence: "Chapter VI - Powers, Functions and Procedure ... (ss. 27-28)" and "Chapter VIII - Penalties and Adjudication (ss. 33-34)"

expectations.text: Does not cite any 'Section 31 limitation for filing complaints' (Section 31 is alternate dispute resolution)
expectations.evidence: "Section 31 covers alternate dispute resolution (mediation)" - no limitation-period claim
